title: Partner incident challenge
scenario: Your partner causes one problem in the shop. Find it and protect customers as quickly as you can. Then swap roles.
why: One good refresh can be luck. Explain the cause and check the shop three times before stopping the timer.
reproduce: Start with a working shop. Your partner chooses Lighting inventory or Shipping and adds one fault: delay, changing delay, disconnect, some failed requests, or wrong or missing values. Do not look at the fault settings. Use the shop, Grafana and Fallbacks & timeouts to find a useful fix.
assignment: Who can explain the problem and protect customers faster?

fields.label: Round setup
fields.prompt: Who introduces the fault and who investigates? Agree on similar difficulty and what a good result looks like.

fields.label: Normal shop and prediction
fields.prompt: Record normal stock and shipping. Which other products might be affected by one slow service?

fields.label: Both rounds: cause and time
fields.prompt: Record each fault after the reveal, your explanation, elapsed seconds and what you saw in the shop and Grafana.

fields.label: Settings and reasons
fields.prompt: Record the settings for both rounds. Explain what each timeout, fallback, breaker or response check helped with.

fields.label: Check the shop three times
fields.prompt: Leave each fault on. Record three refreshes. What still worked? What information stayed unavailable?

fields.label: Compare and reset
fields.prompt: Compare both times fairly. What would you try differently? Clear the faults, restore defaults and check the shop works normally again.

solution: Find the cause using the shop and Grafana. Keep the fault on and check the result three times.
For a long wait, use a shorter timeout and fallback. A breaker can also pause repeated failed requests.
If Shipping cannot answer, fallback asks the backup company. The breaker saves repeated attempts, but cannot provide delivery information itself.
For wrong or missing values, enable Check response data for the affected service and apply its settings. This hides bad information without using fallback.
Compare both rounds fairly. Clear faults, restore defaults and check normal results return.

competition.title: Timed partner round
competition.rules: Your partner applies one fault and says go. Start the timer. Leave the fault on. Explain the cause, choose your settings and refresh three times. Working products must stay usable. Missing information must be clearly marked; wrong values must be hidden. Then stop the timer and swap roles. Removing the fault does not count as a fix.
competition.record: Record both times, faults and settings below. Agree on what a good result looks like before each round. Clear all faults and restore defaults between rounds. The timer does not check your answers.
